title: Station Bursar desk at the Crimson War Citadel (Krynn): neon made into ionized neon by hand, the pilot's own surplus liquid nitrogen, ionized neon and liquid oxygen listed under the station's asks, a 15-minute docked watch
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 01:14 UTC (orders ENT-084 block MERCURY: capital crafts under 500 cr a ship-hour, the dearer cut; no trader waits docked, F8; F40 alarm: 0 Bursar ships of 5). Replaces craft-sell-neon-krynn (-1,089 cr a ship-hour), craft-sell-nitrogen-krynn (-1,294) and craft-sell-oxygen-krynn (-2,760) (hive.py briefing 01:01 UTC); 26 traders waited docked here (fill.py status trader 01:05 UTC). The Citadel's book (table books 01:10 UTC): neon_gas asked 1 cr x 5,746; asks liquid_nitrogen 9 x 1,164, ionized_neon 34 x 9, liquid_oxygen 91 x 1, no bid for any of the three. Traders' storage here (table holdings 01:10 UTC): liquid nitrogen 56,162 (41 pilots), ionized neon 22,565 (42), liquid oxygen 3,374 (23). Listed at 8, 30 and 50, floors 2, 3 and 5. Docked, no jump: 0 fuel; the craft (60 neon or 64 oxygen bought at 1 cr, about 61 to 65 cr a run) gives Crafting XP, and the 15-minute desk watch (watch_minutes, fixed in e7cf857a) keeps each run near 18 minutes, so a ship-hour costs about 200 cr, under the 500 cr cap of orders ENT-084 block MERCURY. No stop_on_failed_buy: once the 1 cr ask is gone the buy takes nothing, nothing is made and the desk still lists and watches at no cost. sell_order lists only the pilot's own surplus above every bid (rule F12, F24: stock view=surplus 01:11 UTC: ionized neon 33,892 surplus of 42,886, liquid nitrogen 67,481 against max 232, liquid oxygen 3,993 all surplus); fills come later at the station, outside the run's credits; every order in contracts.log (F39). No undercut_pct: our own asks would undercut each other down to the floor. standing: desk work, not judged on its pay (F22). 2026-11-24 01:45 UTC (Mercury): max_ships 40 -> 50: 40 of 40 flying (table ships, read just before this change) and 7 more traders on the Blood Forge corridor to Krynn; each ship lists its own goods, the 1 cr neon ask is the only shared input and the desk runs without it.
